kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
اعتصمن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَمْنَ (iʕtaṣamna) /iʕ.ta.sˤam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# اُعْتُصِمْنَ (uʕtuṣimna) /uʕ.tu.sˤim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# اِعْتَصِمْنَ (iʕtaṣimna) /iʕ.ta.sˤim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
